### Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – June 25, 2026

#### Hotfix Update

This is a hotfix containing gameplay updates and bug fixes. Replay codes from the June 16 patch are still available.

#### Hero Updates

![Shion](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/zyDD/256X256/patch-2026-06-25-8499295f51-01-t.png)

##### Shion

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/ftAn/128X128/patch-2026-06-25-8499295f51-02-t.png)

Execution

* Projectile size reduced from 0.17 to 0.07.
* Recovery time increased from 0 to 0.4s.

#### Stadium Updates

Following the recent sweeping Stadium changes, we've been keeping a close eye on the performance of all heroes, their powers, and items. We're tuning down some early overperformers while buffing some of the underperforming new powers to help them find a clearer niche. We'll continue to monitor some of the more frustrating powers and items and make adjustments as necessary.

General

Three Tap Tommygun

* Cost increased to 10500 (Up from 10000).

Salvaged Slugs

* Ammo Restore Chance increased to 60% (Up from 50%).
* Healing increased to 20% (Up from 15%).

Alternative Energy

* Buff duration now resets upon gaining additional stacks.

#### Bug Fixes

General

* In a previous update, fixed a bug that resulted in Ashe's Take Aim damage falling off too quickly.

Stadium

* Fixed a bug where Reaper's Wall of Life and Death Power would not heal allies if they were not within range upon initial cast.
* Fixed a bug where casting Dragonblade while Deflecting with Dragon's Breath and Iaido Strike Powers equipped would not properly trigger Dragon's Breath.
* Fixed a bug with Ashe's Calamity Power that allowed players to acquire more ammo than intended.
* Fixed a bug with Moira's Chain Grasp Power where Biotic Grasp would only chain to 1 additional target.
* Fixed a bug where D.Va's Dae-Hyun Detonator Hero Item would not grant 15% starting Ultimate Charge.
* Fixed a bug where Mei's Ice Sheet Hero Item was not granting the correct stats.
* Fixed a bug where Ana's Cluster Core Item was not granting Ability Power.
* Fixed a bug where Soldier: 76's Rapid Response Radius Item did not increase Biotic Field's duration.
* Fixed a bug where Kiriko's Good Fortune Power did not work with Projectile Speed.
* Fixed a bug where Biotic Bullseye's effect would trigger off Three Tap Tommygun's DOT.
* Fixed a bug where Exo Springs still counted as a Gadget for certain items.
* Fixed a bug where Wuyang's Waveshatter didn't affect Splash Strike's damage.
* Fixed a bug where Genji's Dragon Strike would prevent Dragon Blade's Ultimate VO to play.
* Fixed a bug where Genji's Cybernetic Speed Power granted less Attack Speed than intended.
* Fixed a bug where Reinhardt's Iron Drift did not properly knock back enemies when cancelling Charge.
* Fixed a bug where Wuyang's Current Confluence would heal allies for less than intended.
* Fixed a bug where using Gadgets on D.Va would not trigger certain Item effects.
* Fixed a bug where combining Necrotic Repellant and Repulsion Greaves would cause Repulsion Greave's knockback effect to also hinder.
* Fixed a bug where Moira's Spectral Beam power would shorten Coalescence Duration if used in quick succession.

### 《守望先锋》正式服更新说明 – 2026年6月25日

#### 热修复更新

本次热修复包含了游戏性更新和错误修复。6月16日更新的录像代码仍然有效。

#### 英雄更新

![死怨](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/zyDD/256X256/patch-2026-06-25-8499295f51-01-t.png)

##### 死怨

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/ftAn/128X128/patch-2026-06-25-8499295f51-02-t.png)

处决

* 弹道大小从0.17缩小至0.07。
* 恢复时间从0秒增加至0.4秒。

#### 角斗领域更新

在近期对角斗领域进行全面改动后，我们一直在密切关注所有英雄、他们的异能以及物品的表现。我们正在下调一些早期表现过强的异能，同时增强一些表现不佳的新异能，以帮助它们找到更清晰的定位。我们将继续监控一些较容易引起挫败感的异能和物品，并在必要时进行调整。

综合

三发点射汤姆逊

* 花费从10000增加至10500。

回收独头弹

* 弹药恢复几率从50%增加至60%。
* 治疗量从15%增加至20%。

替代能源

#### 错误修复

常规

* 在之前的更新中，修复了导致艾什的“瞄准射击”伤害衰减过快的错误。

角斗领域

* 修复了死神的“生死之墙”异能如果在初始施放时盟友不在范围内，则无法治疗盟友的错误。
* 修复了在装备“龙息”和“居合击”异能时，在“闪”期间施放“斩”无法正确触发“龙息”的错误。
* 修复了艾什的“灾祸”异能允许玩家获得超出预期弹药量的错误。
* 修复了莫伊拉的“连锁吸附”异能导致“生化之握”只能连锁至1个额外目标的错误。
* 修复了D.Va的英雄物品“大贤起爆器”无法提供15%初始终极技能充能的错误。
* 修复了美的英雄物品“冰层”无法提供正确属性的错误。
* 修复了安娜的物品“集束核心”无法提供技能强度的错误。
* 修复了士兵：76的物品“快速响应半径”无法增加“生物力场”持续时间的错误。
* 修复了雾子的“好运”异能对弹道速度不生效的错误。
* 修复了“生物靶心”的效果会由“三连发冲锋枪”的持续伤害触发的错误。
* 修复了“动力弹簧”对某些物品仍被视为装置的错误。
* 修复了无漾的“碎浪”无法影响“飞溅打击”伤害的错误。
* 修复了源氏的“龙击”会阻止“斩”的终极技能语音播放的错误。
* 修复了源氏的“赛博速度”异能提供的攻击速度低于预期的错误。
* 修复了莱因哈特的“钢铁漂移”在取消“冲锋”时无法正确击退敌人的错误。
* 修复了无漾的“汇流”对盟友的治疗量低于预期的错误。
* 修复了在D.Va身上使用装置无法触发某些物品效果的错误。
* 修复了结合使用“驱死剂”和“斥力护胫”会导致“斥力护胫”的击退效果同时造成阻碍的错误。
* 修复了如果连续快速使用莫伊拉的“幽魂光束”异能，会缩短“聚合射线”持续时间的错误。
